name: Dust Boys
source:
After escaping their family house, brothers Andre (19) and Zion (10) try to navigate only making it day to day.
As they move from a beautiful spring hill to markets torn down and memories with new endings, Zion begins to sense there’s more to their story than Andre lets on. A forgotten father. A hatred buried down. A grief too big for them both.
Zion starts to uncover the long died out fire himself, memories true and false burning his eyes as the smoky silence left in their mother’s absence hangs in the air.
"Once the lights have turned on, you realise that you've been in the dark for a long time."

A fun, emotionally charged one shot story about grief, memories, and the love that survives even when everything else falls apart.

[From [url=https://lysandertime.itch.io/dust-boys]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
安德烈 (19岁) 和锡安 (10岁) 兄弟逃离家门后，试图导航，但只能日复一日地过日子。
当他们从美丽的春天山丘搬到被拆毁的市场和具有新结局的记忆时，锡安开始感觉到他们的故事比安德烈所透露的更多。一个被遗忘的父亲。一股仇恨被埋没了。对他们两人来说，悲伤都太大了。
锡安开始亲自揭开那早已熄灭的大火，真实与虚假的记忆灼烧着他的双眼，母亲不在后留下的烟雾般的寂静悬在空气中。
“一旦灯亮了，你就会意识到自己已经在黑暗中待了很长一段时间了。”

这是一个有趣、充满情感的单一镜头故事，讲述了悲伤、回忆，以及即使一切都崩溃了也依然存在的爱。

[来自[url=https://lysandertime.itch.io/dust-boys]Itch.io[/url]]
